headline: Northern Arc Capital restricts insider trading starting October 1
hook: Trading window closure for Northern Arc insiders
summary: Northern Arc Capital has announced the closure of its trading window for designated persons effective October 1, 2026. This is a standard regulatory compliance measure during which company insiders are prohibited from trading in the firm's securities. The window will remain closed until 48 hours after the declaration of the company's financial results. This procedural update ensures adherence to SEBI's insider trading regulations.
whats_next: Reopening of trading window 48 hours after Q2 results
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no impact on retail investor holdings.
